retranslation.stated_basis: Both reports state that balances are translated at the year-end rates: p41 'Balances have been translated at exchange rates prevailing at 31 December 2017 in all cases'; p42 'Balances have been translated at exchange rates prevailing at 31 December 2016 in all cases'. Every compared cell for the underwriting years before 2016 (2011 to 2015) moved down by about 6 to 8% (e.g. UY2011 end 42.0 vs 44.7 = 0.94; UY2011 five years later 62.6 vs 66.4 = 0.94; UY2015 one year later 43.7 vs 45.7 = 0.96), consistent with retranslation across the +9.66% GBP/USD move; the older block 'for 2010 & Prior years' also moved 9.0 vs 11.8.
